name: Sprites (Fly.io)
description: Gives agents persistent Linux computers with checkpoint and restore, per-Sprite HTTPS URLs, and credential-free connectors, via a CLI, REST API, SDKs, and remote MCP server.

skills.name: Persistent Disk
skills.description: Keeps a 100 GB filesystem across sleep and wake so installs and data stay in place.

skills.name: Checkpoints
skills.description: Snapshots the whole writable filesystem in about a second and restores to any checkpoint.

skills.name: Sprite URLs
skills.description: Gives each Sprite its own HTTPS URL that wakes it on request.

skills.name: Connectors
skills.description: Calls GitHub, OpenRouter, Slack, or any HTTP API without the credential entering the Sprite.

skills.name: Sprites MCP Server
skills.description: Lets MCP clients use Sprites over OAuth at sprites.dev/mcp without a local install.
